title.id: Zenith 2.0 (12 Nov): cocok dengan data game terbaru (1.10.0.1)
title.en: Zenith 2.0 (Nov 12): matches the latest game data (1.10.0.1)

id: Game update (data 1.10.0.1): data terjemahan disesuaikan. Setelah game di-update sampai lobi, tekan Suntik Data. Tidak perlu Pulihkan Data.
173 teks baru diterjemahkan: talent & kartu baru (Kaisar Tiba, Era Emas, Start Gear Dewa, dll.), event Festival Duo, Super Weekend, Mode Cepat, peringatan permainan pasif.
Istilah 棋手 kini "Kontestan" (sebelumnya Taktisi), termasuk "EXP Kontestan" dan "HP Kontestan" di teks kartu.
Tombol lobi "Battle Training" kini juga bertuliskan "MULAI GAME".
Masih Mandarin: badge faksi di pop-up kartu, gambar nama kontestan di judul Lineup, dan tugas mingguan Battle Pass.
en: Game updated (data 1.10.0.1): translation data matched to it. After updating the game to the lobby, press Inject Data. No need to Restore Data.
173 new texts translated: new talents & cards (Imperial Arrival, Golden Age, Divine Gear Start, etc.), Duo Festival event, Super Weekend, Quick Mode, passive-play warnings.
Still in Chinese: faction badges in card pop-ups, chessplayer name images in Lineup titles, and Battle Pass weekly tasks.
